inputs.coverage: Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. The constraint lens uses gray for stereo control, blue for limb silhouettes, and ochre for poorly constrained terrain. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The cartographic north direction follows the long axis at the 2010 encounter, not a spin pole. Hartley 2 tumbles; this display holds an arbitrary rotational phase and does not simulate that motion.
